stage.note: No priced round has been publicly disclosed. Company is a current Y Combinator batch company (S25, standard YC deal implies a pre-seed-level investment); no seed/Series A press, Crunchbase, or blog announcement found. Team size listed by YC as 2.

note: Cyberdesk (founders Mahmoud Al-Madi and Alan) is a Y Combinator Summer 2025 (S25) batch company, status Active, website https://www.cyberdesk.io matches the YC listing (confirms the hint). It is a desktop-automation/computer-use agent platform for Windows; customers supply their own machines (Cyberdriver agent), billed per automation step. No funding round beyond YC's batch investment, no investor list, and no revenue figures were found in ~15 minutes of searching (DuckDuckGo blocked by bot-challenge for several queries; Crunchbase blocked by Cloudflare); Launch HN post from the founders found but contains no financial figures.
